description: Conversion-gain switch ISO, base ISO and 'processed Hi ISO' thresholds per body (docs/06-noise.md, section Priors, Gain regimes). The table is our own, taken from public measurements quoted in docs/06 and research/notes/noise-estimation.md; every row is to be confirmed on samples, and data from public_priors.py overrides it. switch_iso: the high-gain regime starts at this ISO (null = no break, wide prior). base_iso: ISOs below it use the gain of base_iso (null = 100). processed_hi_iso_above: ISOs above this look processed, so the prior is widened (null = not known).
